error[ZBX-E1208]: --lazy does not work with another option given
  cause  '--lazy' serves an image's files as the container reads them, and does
         not take '--rootfs'
  fix    leave out --lazy, or the other option
  more   zbx explain E1208 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1208.html
